tools.name: v1_get_ip_ranges
tools.title: List Datadog IP ranges
tools.description: List the current public IP ranges used by Datadog services.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: Search incidents by service, team, status, urgency, or time. Use for discovery when no identifier is known, while get_incident returns one incident in full.

date_range.description: When set to all, the since and until parameters and defaults are ignored.

incident_key.description: Incident de-duplication key. Incidents with child alerts do not have an incident key; querying by incident key will return incidents whose alerts have alert_key matching the given incident key.

include.description: Array of additional details to include.

limit.description: The number of results per page. Maximum of 100.

offset.description: Offset to start pagination search results.

service_ids.description: Returns only the incidents associated with the passed service(s). This expects one or more service IDs.

since.description: The start of the date range over which you want to search. Maximum range is 6 months and default is 1 month.

sort_by.description: Used to specify both the field you wish to sort the results on (incident_number/created_at/resolved_at/urgency), as well as the direction (asc/desc) of the results. The sort_by field and direction should be separated by a colon. A maximum of two fields can be included, separated by a comma. Sort direction defaults to ascending. The account must have the `urgencies` ability to sort by the urgency.

statuses.description: Return only incidents with the given statuses. To query multiple statuses, pass `statuses[]` more than once, for example: `https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents?statuses[]=triggered&statuses[]=acknowledged`. (More status codes may be introduced in the future.)

team_ids.description: An array of team IDs. Only results related to these teams will be returned. Account must have the `teams` ability to use this parameter.

time_zone.description: Time zone used to render timestamps and to interpret `since/until` values before filtering. Rendering defaults to UTC if omitted. `since/until` default to the account's time zone if omitted.

total.description:
By default the `total` field in pagination responses is set to `null` to provide the fastest possible response times. Set `total` to `true` for this field to be populated.

See our [Pagination Docs](https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/rest-api-v2/pagination/) for more information.

until.description: The end of the date range over which you want to search. Maximum range is 6 months and default is 1 month.

urgencies.description: Array of the urgencies of the incidents to be returned. Defaults to all urgencies. Account must have the `urgencies` ability to do this.

user_ids.description: Returns only the incidents currently assigned to the passed user(s). This expects one or more user IDs. Note: When using the assigned_to_user filter, you will only receive incidents with statuses of triggered or acknowledged. This is because resolved incidents are not assigned to any user.

tools.name: create_incident
tools.title: Create an Incident
tools.description: Open a new incident on a service and start its escalation. Use when a person or agent needs to declare an incident, while update_incident changes one that is already open.

body.description: JSON request body for this PagerDuty operation.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: Search technical services by name, team, or integration. Use for discovery, while list_business_services covers the customer-facing layer above them.

include.description: Array of additional details to include.

limit.description: The number of results per page.

name.description: Filters the results, showing only services with the specified name.

offset.description: Offset to start pagination search results.

query.description: Filters the result, showing only the records whose name matches the query.

sort_by.description: Used to specify the field you wish to sort the results on.

team_ids.description: An array of team IDs. Only results related to these teams will be returned. Account must have the `teams` ability to use this parameter.

time_zone.description: Time zone in which results will be rendered. This will default to the account time zone.

total.description:
By default the `total` field in pagination responses is set to `null` to provide the fastest possible response times. Set `total` to `true` for this field to be populated.

See our [Pagination Docs](https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/rest-api-v2/pagination/) for more information.

tools.name: web_search
tools.title: Web Search
tools.description: Search the public internet for current information, news, announcements, and general web content, returning relevant results with normalized text snippets.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.title: Web Fetch
tools.description: Fetch and extract public web page content with Exa.

max_characters.description: Maximum extracted text characters to return.

url.description: Public web page URL to fetch.

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.title: Answer a question with Perplexity Sonar
tools.description: Answer a conversation with a reply grounded in a live web search, returned with its citation URLs and search results. Use for a quick cited answer; pick create_async_chat_completion for a long deep-research report.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate in the answer.

messages.description: Conversation so far, oldest first. The final message is normally the user's question.

model.description: Sonar model to answer with, for example sonar or sonar-deep-research. Call list_models for the values this account may use.

return_related_questions.description: Also return follow-up questions related to the answer.

search_mode.description: Corpus to ground the answer in, for example web or academic.

search_recency_filter.description: Restrict grounding sources by age, for example day, week, month, or year.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Lower is more deterministic.

annotations.title: Answer a question with Perplexity Sonar

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search the web with Perplexity
tools.description: Run a live web or people search and get ranked results with titles, URLs, snippets, and publication dates. Use when the user wants raw sources to read; pick chat_completion for a written answer with citations.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to bias results toward, for example US or DE.

max_results.description: Maximum results to return. Up to 20 for web search, up to 50 when search_type is people. Defaults to 10.

max_tokens_per_page.description: Maximum content tokens to extract from each result page.

query.description: The search query, in natural language or keywords.

search_language_filter.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes to restrict results to.

search_type.description: Search corpus: web for general pages, people for person profiles. Defaults to web.

bcc.description: The email addresses of the blind carbon copy recipients.

cc.description: The email addresses of the carbon copy recipients.

created_at.description: The date and time the email was created.

from.description: The email address of the sender.

html.description: The HTML body of the email.

reply_to.description: The email addresses to which replies should be sent.

subject.description: The subject line of the email.

text.description: The plain text body of the email.

items.description: The email addresses of the recipients.

has_more.description: Indicates if there are more results available.

audience_id.description: Unique identifier of the audience to which the contact belongs.

properties.description: A map of custom property keys and values to create.

segments.description: Array of segment IDs to add the contact to.

topics.description: Array of topic subscriptions for the contact.

subscription.description: The subscription status for this topic.

unsubscribed.description: The Contact's global subscription status. If set to true, the contact will be unsubscribed from all Broadcasts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the created contact.
